channel.title: Field Notes
channel.description: Rides, hikes and foraging walks in the high desert and the Sierra, written up by Christian Gehrke and told as short episodes by a narrator who came along. Episodes are narrated by an AI voice, reading a script written from Christian's own notes, track and photos.
channel.itunes:author: Christian Gehrke

item.title: Clear Creek after dark
item.description: Spooner Summit to James Lee Park on the Clear Creek Trail with his brother and nephew, visiting from Buffalo, New York, on their first ride in years. The last stretch was by bike light.

item.title: The whales of Whale Beach
item.description: A sunset ride down to Whale Beach on Lake Tahoe's east shore, with his wife and Marley walking down. An hour on the beach, polished carnelian in the sand, and Marley swimming the whole time.
